import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {

    static final int MAX_DIM = 300;

    static final int BLANK = -1;
    static final int REACTOR = -2;
    static final int HAZARD_ZONE = -3;
    static final int SAFE = BLANK;

    static class Connection {
        int start, finish, back, flow, cap;

        Connection() {
            start = 0;
            finish = 0;
            back = 0;
            flow = 0;
            cap = 0;
        }

        Connection(int s, int f, int b, int fl, int c) {
            start = s;
            finish = f;
            back = b;
            flow = fl;
            cap = c;
        }

        int left() {
            return cap - flow;
        }
    }

    static class DinicLike {
        int V;
        List<List<Connection>> adj;
        Connection[][] prevEdge;
        int[] dist;

        DinicLike(int n) {
            V = n;
            adj = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            prevEdge = new Connection[n][];
            dist = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(dist, -1);
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
            Connection f = new Connection(u, v, adj.get(v).size(), 0, c);
            Connection r = new Connection(v, u, adj.get(u).size(), 0, 0);
            adj.get(u).add(f);
            adj.get(v).add(r);
        }

        void addBiEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
            Connection f = new Connection(u, v, adj.get(v).size(), 0, c);
            Connection r = new Connection(v, u, adj.get(u).size(), 0, c);
            adj.get(u).add(f);
            adj.get(v).add(r);
        }

        boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(dist, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            dist[s] = 0;

            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                if (u == t) return true;
                for (Connection e : adj.get(u)) {
                    if (dist[e.finish] == -1 && e.left() > 0) {
                        dist[e.finish] = dist[u] + 1;
                        q.offer(e.finish);
                    }
                }
            }
            return false;
        }

        int dfs(int u, int t, int flowIn, Connection[][] prevEdgeArr) {
            if (u == t) return flowIn;
            for (int i = 0; i < prevEdgeArr[u].length; i++) {
                Connection e = prevEdgeArr[u][i];
                if (e == null) continue;
                if (dist[e.finish] == dist[u] + 1 && e.left() > 0) {
                    int pushed = dfs(e.finish, t, Math.min(flowIn, e.left()), prevEdgeArr);
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        e.flow += pushed;
                        adj.get(e.finish).get(e.back).flow -= pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long flow(int s, int t) {
            long total = 0;
            while (bfs(s, t)) {
                for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) {
                    List<Connection> list = adj.get(i);
                    prevEdge[i] = list.toArray(new Connection[0]);
                }
                int f;
                while ((f = dfs(s, t, Integer.MAX_VALUE, prevEdge)) > 0) {
                    total += f;
                }
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    static int[][] world = new int[MAX_DIM][MAX_DIM];
    static int[][] safeCap = new int[MAX_DIM][MAX_DIM];
    static int[][][] toxicTime = new int[61][MAX_DIM][MAX_DIM];

    static class Agent {
        int r, c, amount;

        Agent(int x, int y, int n) {
            r = x;
            c = y;
            amount = n;
        }

        boolean valid(int sz) {
            return r >= 0 && r < sz && c >= 0 && c < sz && world[r][c] == BLANK;
        }
    }

    static boolean inRange(int x, int y, int sz) {
        return new Agent(x, y, 0).valid(sz);
    }

    static int[] dr = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dc = {0, -1, 0, 1};

    static int mapChar(char c) {
        if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') return BLANK;
        if (c == 'Y') return REACTOR;
        if (c == 'Z') return HAZARD_ZONE;
        return -1;
    }

    static int parseNum(char c) {
        return c - '0';
    }

    static int bfsTime(Agent src, Agent dst, int sz) {
        boolean[][] seen = new boolean[MAX_DIM][MAX_DIM];
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{0, src.r, src.c});
        seen[src.r][src.c] = true;

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int t = cur[0];
            int r = cur[1];
            int c = cur[2];

            if (r == dst.r && c == dst.c) return t;
            if (toxicTime[t][r][c] == 1) continue;

            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nr = r + dr[k];
                int nc = c + dc[k];
                Agent next = new Agent(nr, nc, 0);
                if (next.valid(sz) && !seen[nr][nc] && toxicTime[t][nr][nc] == 0) {
                    q.offer(new int[]{t + 1, nr, nc});
                    seen[nr][nc] = true;
                }
            }
        }
        return 999;
    }

    static void spreadToxic(int x, int y, int T, int sz) {
        toxicTime[0][x][y] = 1;
        for (int t = 1; t <= T; ++t) {
            for (int i = 0; i < sz; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < sz; ++j) {
                    if (toxicTime[t-1][i][j] == 1) {
                        toxicTime[t][i][j] = 1;
                        for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                            int ni = i + dr[k], nj = j + dc[k];
                            if (ni >= 0 && ni < sz && nj >= 0 && nj < sz && world[ni][nj] == BLANK)
                                toxicTime[t][ni][nj] = 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int N = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        int T = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);

        List<Agent> victims = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Agent> shelters = new ArrayList<>();
        Agent hazard = new Agent(0, 0, 0);

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                if (mapChar(ch) == BLANK && parseNum(ch) > 0) {
                    victims.add(new Agent(i, j, parseNum(ch)));
                }
                world[i][j] = mapChar(ch);
                if (world[i][j] == HAZARD_ZONE) {
                    hazard = new Agent(i, j, 0);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                if (mapChar(ch) == SAFE && parseNum(ch) > 0) {
                    shelters.add(new Agent(i, j, parseNum(ch)));
                    safeCap[i][j] = parseNum(ch);
                }
            }
        }

        DinicLike flowNet = new DinicLike(MAX_DIM);
        int sinkNode = MAX_DIM - 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < victims.size(); ++i) {
            flowNet.addEdge(0, i*2 + 1, victims.get(i).amount);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < shelters.size(); ++i) {
            flowNet.addEdge(i*2 + 2, sinkNode, shelters.get(i).amount);
        }

        spreadToxic(hazard.r, hazard.c, T, N);

        for (int i = 0; i < victims.size(); ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < shelters.size(); ++j) {
                int d = bfsTime(victims.get(i), shelters.get(j), N);
                if (d <= T) {
                    flowNet.addEdge(i*2 + 1, j*2 + 2, 999);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(flowNet.flow(0, sinkNode));
    }
}
